profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a well-rounded, jack-of-all-trades, full stack developer who can developer creative solutions for complex problems. But more important than good code, I can promise that I will be a positive impact on team collaboration, culture and attitude on the team. I firmly believe that the soft skills like communication, respect, and an attitude of service, are what will drive a team to success.
Reach out and find out how I can help you succeed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build job requisition list processing using ml job matching to improve internal team efficiency
- Rebuilt talent scheduling and screening system, replacing Calendly
- Refactor onboarding screening scheduling with default scheduling system, boosting initial talent screening volume
- Initiate frontend and backend collaborative sessions (guilds) to improve group drive towards system and tooling updates, code consistency, tech debt cleanup, and forward looking vision on new technology
- Initiate engineering team demo session to improve casual collaboration, raise awareness of new product features across team, and improve remote team relationship
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · Iterable Cross-Channel Marketing · Software Design · Anthropic Claude

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed automated expense system using PEX, to allow workers to request funds from their phone, as well as upload the receipt for record keeping and auditing. 60+ hours save per week
• Updated mapping to improve utility for customers. Includes developing APIs to provide necessary information as well as working with Google Maps, Next.js, and React Native mapping to provide a both functional and pleasing experience.
• Added geolocation capabilities for our search experience. Captured and utilized GeoJSON, along with PostGIS and RGeo, to allow for more granular search as well as adding an updated map UI look which included boundary lines for your search.
• Led effort to update core Rails application from v6 to v7.
• Worked with our Supply and Demand team to provide tools and functionality to better capture demand and provide a more refined experience, connecting that demand with great supply.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for managing workloads across multiple projects and clients in parallel:

• Prioritize and balance new features and system improvements against limited budgets and differing deadlines.
• Work closely with clients and other non-technical staff to translate business requirements into well defined technical solutions.
• Collaborate with project managers to schedule sprints in both team and solo developer scenarios.

Develop and improve legacy Grails and Python application:

• Facilitated server OS upgrade, including rewriting of DevOps stack from Puppet to Ansible. Utilizing tools like git, Tomcat, Apache, and AWS EC2, S3 and RDS.
• Refactor application code, reducing incident of error and improving maintainability.
• Refactored Python batch processes to Grails, reducing maintenance load and improving performance by 24x.

Developed ICD10 (CDC) search tool (https://icd10cmtool.cdc.gov/):

• Replaced an older Angular application with a React application.
• Used TypeScript to improve maintainability and Redux to handle routing.

Supported, led, and completed development of REST API using Grails, supporting a Node and React front end:

• Created multi-stage, resumable workflows that allowed for management of project participants from sign up to completion over multiple years.
• Integrated Grails user authentication with Login.gov and IdentityServer to allow for federated user access to the system.
• Developed in-house solution to allow Grails user access management based on roles (RBAC) as well as user attributes and attributes of the requested action (ABAC).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a senior engineer I took a larger role in the non-code aspects of development. I mentored junior engineers, helping them address their strengths and weaknesses so they can grow efficiently and contribute quickly. I addressed company needs, designing new solutions for problems and feature requests. I would then follow through on the design with project planning, delegation to team, and development of the design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I helped develop and design an internal CMS (content managment system), using the Grails application framework, to manage a large library of videos from various perspectives including acquisition, storage, distribution, licensing, accounting, and rights management. I was responsible for managing task load and estimation, as well as developing well thought out and well tested solutions for the task at hand.

• Developed billing system by integrating Bill.com and Tiplati APIs. The system would take revenue and licensing information and automatically generate reports, invoices, and send out payments to 1000s of clients each month.

• Developed automated video hosting system using Kaltura and Brightcove to allow our team to effectively pitch, license, and distribute to our licensing clients.

• Developed rights management tool using YouTube APIs to allow the rights management team to more quickly handle copyright concerns.

• Integrated app with AWS S3 to manage file storage, backups, and time sensitive private distributions.

• Developed multi step company workflow that allowed teams to collaborate automatically as a new video would move from research to acquisition, and eventually licensing, monetization, and billing.

• Developed video ingestion solution using Rails, AWS S3, youtube-dl and ffmpeg libraries, for 
efficient capture, encoding, and storage of acquired videos.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I worked with my team to develop quick and thoughtful solutions for our clients in the Oil & Gas industry. Using technologies like Grails, SQL, and D3.js, I developed solutions that brought our front end experience into a modern space.

• Developed Grails application targeted towards SCADA operations in the Oil & Gas industry.
• Developed D3.js based charting platform, replacing an older Flash platform.
• Developed analytic reports for clients using PostgreSQL and MySQL.
• Maintained and improved frond end codebase.
• Worked with clients to address needs and concerns, implementing solutions quickly and correctly.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · React.js · MySQL · Integration Testing · Java · Groovy · Grails · SQL · Git · CSS · Client Relations · HTML · Problem Solving · Software Development · Unit Testing · JavaScript · D3.js · d3.js · Web Applications · jQuery · PostgreSQL
